changelog:
### VietLab v1.0.5 - On dinh ket noi may tram, Toi gian Client Tray & Chong nhay man hinh GV

- Khac phuc triet de loi lap ket noi/ngat ket noi: Bo sung Single-Instance Mutex chong chay trung lap tien trinh Client, dong bo SemaphoreSlim va khoa trang thai ket noi chong xung dot UDP Beacon.
- Chuyen tiep ngat ket noi thong minh tren Server: Chi danh dau may tram offline khi khong con bat ky ket noi hop le nao, loai bo tinh trang nhay trang thai.
- Toi uu man hinh giam sat Giao vien: Ap dung bo dem debounce giam tan suat ve lai luoi giam sat, triet tieu hoan toan hien tuong nhay/chop man hinh.
- Cooldown Toast chong spam: Tu dong chan hien thong bao luan phien khi mang chap chon trong vong 8 giay.
- Toi gian Icon Tray tren may con: Tinh gon menu chi giu lai nut mo Cong thong tin phong may va Thoat quan tri; chuyen toan bo tuong tac hoc sinh len Cong thong tin web, giam toi da ap luc cap nhat Client trong tuong lai.
